bugs.bug: a chained `.pipe().pipe()` binds the next pipe to the source subprocess instead of to the previous pipe's promise, so waitForBothProcesses awaits the wrong thing and failures in the series are lost or not reported
bugs.example: setup.js/sequence.js: promise.pipe is bound with the original spawned process, so in a series of pipe() calls waitForBothProcesses waits on the subprocess rather than the previous pipe promise and its failure is not propagated
